transcriber_notes: Very low-resolution (393x486) JPEG screenshot of a SnowPro-style form; no app branding -> source_format 'other'. Most printed text (header values, grain sizes, test results) is blurred; tentative header readings quoted in header.notes. Height axis 1.475 px/cm (gridlines every 10 cm, 0 cm at y460); boundaries read from bar edges +-1.5 cm: 162/151/142/122/100/99/78/54/19/0. Hardness: origin at the right plot edge, F/4F/1F/P/K labels ~7/14/29/58/116 px from it; bars F, 4F, 1F, 1F+, P-, P-, P-, 1F; R-column icons agree. The SH row is drawn only in the table (leader slants into ~99-100 cm), so its thickness is unresolved. Temperatures on 7.5 px/deg C with 0 C at the 4F gridline (calibrated by the dashed air line starting at -9.5 = printed air temp); only clearly visible circles recorded, +-0.3 C and +-1.5 cm. Test leaders end at table row lines in the Comments column, so heights null.
